contact.name: Anastasia Tasoula
contact.evidence_quote: About the Coach ... Anastasia Tasoula is a student of psychology and for 2 years now she is getting educated on personal development methods (life-coaching, NLP methods etc.) and she has been trainer on projects about social, environmental, personal development and health topics. She is a person with a disability, a chronic-terminal illness called cystic fibrosis and she has spent more than 3 years of her life in the hospital – fighting for her life. She knows how it is to feel social excluded – to exclude sometime
